title: The dual-path fixing strategy and its application to the set-covering problem
summary: We introduce the dual-path fixing strategy to exploit dual algorithms for solving relaxations of mixed-integer nonlinear-optimization problems. Such dual algorithms are naturally applied in the context of branch-and-bound, and eventual impact on the success of branch-and-bound is our strong motivation.
